description: Registry of StackShift seeding strategies. Only ONE strategy should be active at a time — recorded in .stackshift/installed.json → seed field. The canonical content for each strategy is at skills/stackshift/seeds/<file>. No skill-folder stub ships (removed 0.5.1).

seeds.title: Initial-Value Seeding
seeds.summary: Extracts content from HTML mockups or hardcoded components and writes realistic placeholder copy into initialValue/index.ts for Sanity Studio authors. Only one seeding strategy should be active at a time.
